title: Bachan's Mall-Court Chicken Teriyaki & Steamed Broccoli Bowl
originalTitle: Bachan's Mall-Court Chicken Teriyaki & Steamed Broccoli Bowl
ingredients: 1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, very thinly sliced
Marinade: 3 tbsp Bachan's Japanese Barbecue Sauce, 1 tbsp cornstarch, 1 tsp toasted sesame oil, 1/2 tsp white pepper, 1/2 tsp black pepper
Glaze Sauce: 1/2 cup chicken stock, 1/3 cup Bachan's Japanese Barbecue Sauce, 1.5 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp cornstarch
1 large head broccoli, cut into florets and steamed
1 large yellow onion, thinly sliced and caramelized
3 cups cooked short-grain white rice & toasted sesame seeds
instructions: Velvet-marinate the thinly sliced chicken thighs with Bachan's Japanese BBQ sauce, cornstarch, sesame oil, white pepper, and black pepper for 15–30 minutes.
Whisk together the glaze sauce of chicken stock, Bachan's sauce, honey, and cornstarch in a small bowl.
Steam the broccoli florets until bright green and tender-crisp; caramelize the sliced onions in a hot skillet or flat-top griddle.

Sear the marinated chicken thighs over high heat until deeply caramelized, toss with the onions and steamed broccoli, pour in the Bachan's-honey-stock slurry, and toss for 60 seconds until glossy. Serve over steamed rice.
notes: Doc Note: Marinate very thinly sliced chicken thighs with corn starch, Bachan's, sesame oil, white pepper, black pepper. Steam broccoli, caramelize onions. Cook chicken, combine with veg. Make rice. Make a sauce with chicken stock, corn starch, Bachan's, honey.
